probes.name: imported-cache-auto
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,p As PivotTable,c As PivotCache,s As String
Application.EnableEvents=False
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
Set p=ws.PivotTables("First")
Set c=p.PivotCache
s="before=[" & RefreshProbe.Snapshot() & "]"
ws.Range("C2").Value2=11
ws.Range("C6").Value2=51
s=s & ";edited=[" & RefreshProbe.Snapshot() & "]"
c.Refresh
s=s & ";after=[" & RefreshProbe.Snapshot() & "]"
Probe=s
End Function
probes.inspection_source:
Function Report(p As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim c As Range,s As String
s=p.Name & ":cache=" & p.CacheIndex & ":range=" & p.TableRange1.Address & ":cells="
For Each c In p.TableRange1.Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & "|"
Next
Report=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Report=s & "ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SourceValues() As String
Dim c As Range,s As String
For Each c In Worksheets("Data").Range("B2:B6").Cells
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & "|"
If Err.Number<>0 Then s=s & "ERR:" & Err.Number & "|"
On Error GoTo 0
Next
SourceValues=s
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
Snapshot="mode=" & Application.Calculation & ":source=" & SourceValues() & ";" & Report(ws.PivotTables("First")) & ";" & Report(ws.PivotTables("Shared")) & ";" & Report(ws.PivotTables("Unrelated"))
Exit Function
Failed:
Snapshot="SNAPSHOT-ERROR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Attempt(c As PivotCache,p As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Boolean
c.Refresh
Attempt="completed"
Exit Function
Failed:
Attempt="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function

Application.EnableEvents=False
ActiveWorkbook.SaveAs "C:\Users\William\.codex\worktrees\pivot-refresh\pyOpenVBA\.cache\pivot-refresh-imported-samples\imported-cache-auto.xlsm",52
End Sub
